page_title: MNU 0-1 EVE | Manchester Utd v Everton 24/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
90+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.
90+3' Mason Mount (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.

90+2' A loose ball is pounced on by Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford is alert and makes a comfortable save.
90+1' A corner kick by Manchester Utd is thwarted by the well prepared Jordan Pickford (Everton).
90+1' Mason Mount (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.

89' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Jordan Pickford displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall will be replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
87' David Moyes has decided to substitute Jack Grealish and he is replaced by Dwight McNeil (Everton).

86' What a chance that is! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
85' 69:31 – the latest ball possession ratio.
81' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) replaces Thierno Barry.
81' Iliman Ndiaye will be replaced by Beto (Everton).

81' What a chance that is! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
81' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

80' Jordan Pickford pulls off a fantastic save! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
78' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Everton get a corner.
77' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Everton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
75' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Tony Harrington had a clear view and blows his whistle.
73' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

71' Mason Mount sprays a pass out to Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
71' James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a foul and Tony Harrington immediately signals a free kick.

69' A long pass finds Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
68' Manchester Utd keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
65' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

63' Mason Mount (Manchester United) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
63' A snap shot by Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Jordan Pickford produces a good save to thwart him.

61' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
60' Manchester Utd enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' Here is a change. Patrick Dorgu is going off and Ruben Amorim gives the last tactical orders to Diogo Dalot (Manchester United).
58' It will be a substitution. Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is ready to enter the pitch as Casemiro walks off.
57' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
56' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
55' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

54' Wasted effort! Casemiro (Manchester United) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
52' Mason Mount (Manchester United) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
51' Mason Mount (Manchester United) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
49' Casemiro (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Tony Harrington and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to find Patrick Dorgu, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
46' Referee Tony Harrington blows his whistle to start the second half.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Noussair Mazraoui is replaced by Mason Mount (Manchester United).
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

45+1' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
45+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will deliver the corner kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the top left corner, but Jordan Pickford was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
45' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
43' A cross into the box from Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is cleared.

42' A brilliant individual effort! Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
40' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' 4:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

33' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Joshua Zirkzee, but he hits a shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.

31' The fans were almost celebrating as Amad Diallo (Manchester United) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford made an astonishing save!

29' 0 - 1 Goal! Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Senne Lammens had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
28' Jack Grealish (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
24' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) plays a through ball but overhits it.
23' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
19' The Manchester Utd players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick, but Jordan Pickford reads it well and stops the effort.
17' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) has been issued a red card.

13' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
12' Thierno Barry (Everton) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
10' David Moyes is forced to make a change. Seamus Coleman is unable to continue due to injury, Jake O'Brien (Everton) comes on.

9' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
8' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
6' The foul by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Thierno Barry (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
4' Manchester Utd are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Everton will kick-off.
Tony Harrington was nominated as the referee for this game.
